name: Files
description: A single-file H5 stock file manager. Every size on screen is a roll-up: a folder has no size of its own, it is the sum of its whole subtree, recomputed on every action, so moving one folder subtracts an entire subtree from one ancestor chain and adds it to another. And there are two volumes, which is where the real lesson lives — moving within a volume changes nothing at all, moving across volumes moves both bars by the same amount, copying only grows the destination, and deleting is the only thing that reduces the total. Internal storage is down to 2.35 GB free and eight gigabytes have to come off it; the WhatsApp video folder is 8,100 MB, ninety-two short, and there is exactly one 92 MB file on the phone. 3 screens, 2 volumes, 40 nodes, a duplicate finder and a locked system folder.

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — both volume bars print used and free, the breadcrumb prints the path with a tappable id per level, and every row prints its rolled-up size, its item count and whether it is locked. Fully navigable without pixels.
